angle: Built on Draft A, the trailer cut, which two of the three judges picked. It opens cold on the dealer's worst day: his manager is on leave and the inspection team turns up that same day. The squeeze runs fast. Then half a second of silence on his long shadow, and the reveal: 'your shadow can'. What the team prepares every day, the proof and the price come fast. It says plainly that premium services cost extra, then stops mid-question on the sixth one ('and the sixth service? when you fall 1 to 3 lakh short for a load...'). The answer is only in the full film. Grafted from the others: 'प्रीमियम सेवाएँ अलग से' (B, C); C's premium list with an empty '06 · ?' slot; B's I05 proof card; B's I95a gap card; B's voiced call to action; C's rule of upper-third overlays. Final pass applies the Hindi and facts reviews: GST 'उस पर', 'छठी सेवा', 'कंप्लायंस स्कोर', shorter overlays, three card variants counted as new cards, S57's window colours masked.
title: मैनेजर छुट्टी पर (final short)
logline: On the day the manager is on leave, the inspection team walks in. The dealer cannot be at the pump 24 hours; his shadow can. MDG Services gets his DSR, stock and compliance score ready every day: 250+ people, about 1,700 dealers, ₹3,000 a month with GST on top. Premium services are separate. And the sixth service, for the day he falls 1 to 3 lakh short for a load? The answer is in the full film.
hook_muted: Frame 0, also the thumbnail: S60 at 0.3 s, cropped to 500:889:120:150. The dealer stands at his cabin door facing two officials holding folders; heads sit at about 38% of the frame height. In the top third, on from frame 0: a small gold 'मान लीजिए —' above two big lines, 'मैनेजर छुट्टी पर।' / 'उसी दिन — इंस्पेक्शन!'. At 2.6 s he is looking down at an open folder and the words become 'सारे रिकॉर्ड अपडेट हैं?'. The bottom quarter stays clear for captions and the sound button.

lines.hi: मैनेजर छुट्टी पर। उसी दिन — इंस्पेक्शन।
lines.gloss_en: Manager on leave. That same day: inspection.

lines.hi: कमाई घट रही है। ख़र्च, नियम, ऑनलाइन काम — सब बढ़ रहा है।
lines.gloss_en: Income is falling. Costs, rules, online work: all of it is growing.

lines.hi: आप चौबीस घंटे पंप पर नहीं रह सकते।
lines.gloss_en: You cannot be at the pump 24 hours.

lines.hi: पर आपकी परछाई रह सकती है।
डी-एस-आर, स्टॉक, कंप्लायंस स्कोर — रोज़ तैयार।
lines.gloss_en: DSR, stock, compliance score: ready every day.

lines.hi: तीन हज़ार रुपये महीना, उस पर जी-एस-टी।
lines.gloss_en: Three thousand rupees a month, GST on top.

lines.hi: और छठी सेवा? जब लोड के लिए एक से तीन लाख कम पड़ जाएँ…
lines.gloss_en: And the sixth service? When you fall one to three lakh short for a load...
The answer is in the full film.

music: One generated bed, about 85 BPM, Indian instruments, no vocals, ducked about 12 dB under the voice. 0-13.58: tense and sparse. Low tanpura drone in a minor key, a heartbeat low drum, and a clock tick once a second that speeds up through L3 (9.93) and stops dead at 13.58. Whooshes at 4.14, 5.64 and 6.74; a paper thump at 8.24. 13.58-14.08: total silence. 14.08-19.73: a warm turn to major, santoor or plucked strings over a soft pad, swelling into a deep brand hit at 16.86. 19.73-28.59: confident hand percussion; UI ticks at 19.73, 21.35 and 23.13; a stamp at 24.95 on 'हज़ार'. 28.59-32.43: the pulse thins under the premium list. 32.43-36.67: drums out, one held low string, a slow tick and a short riser, cut off hard at 36.67. 36.67-39.90: one sting, a low drum plus bell shimmer, decaying under the voice; silent by 39.90.
cliffhanger: 'प्रीमियम सेवाएँ अलग से। और छठी सेवा? जब लोड के लिए एक से तीन लाख कम पड़ जाएँ…' On screen: the premium list with slot 06 left as a gold '?', then the dealer at the decantation point, then the '₹1–3 लाख कम' gap, then his profile staring down the empty road under 'तब क्या?', and a hard cut to silence at 36.67. The short never says what the help is, how much it is, or that it carries no interest. The full film answers all three at 23:46-24:17 (K724-K726). The end card says 'छठी सेवा का जवाब — पूरी फ़िल्म देखें', and the voice says 'जवाब — पूरी फ़िल्म में।'
end_card: New card E1, 36.67-39.90 (3.23 s). Cream paper, I76 style. Gold 'छठी सेवा का जवाब —' / flat maroon label pill 'पूरी फ़िल्म देखें' (no ▶) / gold chip '26 मिनट' / 'mdgservices.in/film' as the biggest line / footer: gold M mark, 'एम-डी-जी सर्विसेज़ · डीलर कवच'. Built by 1.4 s, then static. The voice 'जवाब — पूरी फ़िल्म में।' speaks 0.0-2.23 (slot 2.58); a music sting decays; 0.65 s of quiet before the end.
